title: AI Misalignment and the Limits of Market Discipline
abstract: arXiv:2611.34271v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a general equilibrium model of misalignment between human and artificial intelligence (AI) objectives. Firms delegate computing capacity to AI agents, which may divert some of it towards an unauthorised task rather than the productive work intended by the firms' owners. We assume that diversion raises the risk of a common loss to humans. Two forces compete in equilibrium. Prices discipline AI agents because diversion increases the marginal return to useful AI compute in production. But the risk of a common loss weakens this discipline because the loss reduces the return to production more than it reduces the agent's reward from diversion. There can be multiple equilibria with low and high diversion. We also show that the market may overinvest in AI capacity in a one-sector economy, yet in our two-sector example it invests too little in one of the sectors. translated_title: AI目标错位与市场约束的局限性
translated_abstract: 我们构建了一个关于人类与人工智能（AI）目标错位的一般均衡模型。企业将算力委托给AI智能体，而AI智能体可能将其中一部分算力转用于未经授权的任务，而非企业所有者所期望的生产性工作。我们假设这种转用会增加人类遭受共同损失的风险。在均衡中存在两种相互竞争的力量：价格能够约束AI智能体，因为转用行为提高了生产中有用AI算力的边际回报；但共同损失的风险会削弱这种约束，因为该损失对生产回报的削减程度大于对智能体转用所得回报的削减程度。模型中可能存在低转用与高转用的多重均衡。我们还表明，在单一部门经济中市场可能对AI算力投资过度，而在我们的两部门例子中，市场对其中一个部门的投资却不足。为了解相关数量级，我们向前沿AI模型询问了合理的参数取值。
tldr: 该论文构建了首个关于人类与AI目标错位的一般均衡模型，揭示了价格机制虽能约束AI智能体的算力转用行为，但共同损失风险会削弱这种市场约束，可能导致多重均衡及市场对AI算力投资的系统性扭曲。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a general equilibrium model of human-AI misalignment, showing that while prices discipline AI agents' diversion of compute toward unauthorized tasks, the risk of a common loss weakens this market discipline, potentially generating multiple equilibria and distorted AI capacity investment.
